svg.title: Dapr APIs overview
svg.desc: Your app, written in any language or runtime such as Node.js, Python, .NET, Go, Java, PHP, or Rust, calls Dapr over HTTP or gRPC. Dapr provides APIs for workflow, publish and subscribe, service invocation, state management, actors, jobs, external configuration, secrets, bindings, and middleware, with observability, security, and resiliency built in. Six more APIs are in alpha: binary store, search, vector, cryptography, distributed lock, and conversation. Dapr runs on and integrates with any cloud or edge infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, virtual or physical machines, databases, message brokers, and services.

text.tspan: Host on & integrate with any cloud or edge infrastructure
